task_completion.description: Screaming Frog SEO Spider application is opened and visible.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Screaming Frog GUI window is visible on the desktop.

task_completion.description: The application is switched to 'List' mode.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Mode' menu shows 'List' selected, or the top bar indicates 'Mode: List'.

task_completion.description: The 20 URLs from landing_pages.txt are uploaded into the tool.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Upload' dialog or the main window shows URLs from books.toscrape.com being imported or listed.

task_completion.description: The crawl is initiated and reaches 100% completion.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The progress bar at the bottom or top of the GUI shows 100% and the 'Start' button has changed back from 'Pause/Stop'.

task_completion.description: Internal results are exported as a CSV to the specified exports directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Export' button is clicked in the 'Internal' tab, and a file dialog or terminal confirmation shows a CSV being saved to ~/Documents/SEO/exports/.

task_completion.description: A summary report (landing_page_health.txt) is created in the reports directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal shows the content of ~/Documents/SEO/reports/landing_page_health.txt containing status codes or title issues.

integrity.description: The agent used the Screaming Frog GUI rather than just manipulating files via CLI.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse cursor movement and menu interactions within the Screaming Frog interface.

integrity.description: The agent performed an actual crawl of the URLs.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Internal' tab in Screaming Frog is populated with multiple rows of data (status codes, titles) matching the target domain.

integrity.description: The final report contains actual data from the crawl, not generic placeholders.
integrity.visual_evidence: The report file contains specific references to 'books.toscrape.com' and actual SEO metrics like '200 OK' or specific page titles.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target domain is books.toscrape.com. There are exactly 20 URLs in the source file ~/Documents/SEO/landing_pages.txt. The exported CSV should contain between 15 and 30 rows (accounting for deduplication). The final report must be located at ~/Documents/SEO/reports/landing_page_health.txt and the CSV at ~/Documents/SEO/exports/.
